verdict.rationale: Bruno AI lets users describe intent in natural language to generate scripts, tests, docs, and even full apps (e.g., 'describe what you need' and Bruno generates a script/test/doc), and an AI chat sidebar answers natural-language questions about the workspace. However, this is scoped to specific tabs/actions (Scripts, Tests, Docs) rather than full natural-language control of the entire product (e.g., navigating collections, running requests, managing environments via NL commands), and requires BYO API key setup; no independent/hands-on evidence corroborates real-world reliability of these NL features. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over core workflow actions like running/organizing requests or environments, independent hands-on validation of AI feature quality.
